+            android:screenOrientation="landscape"
+            android:resizeableActivity="false"
+            android:theme="@android:style/Theme.Black.NoTitleBar.Fullscreen">
body:
`GodotXRGame` is an immersive OpenXR activity, so we don't want the activity to render anything at all (hence the black theme) as the rendering is driven by the XR device XR compositor.

See https://developers.meta.com/horizon/documentation/native/android/mobile-native-manifest/ for reference.
